IssueImpact.title: IssueImpact
IssueImpact.description: The impact reference set of one execution issue: the opaque ProgramOfWork schedule items (work packages, activities, milestones) it touches.

WorkPackageId.title: WorkPackageId
WorkPackageId.description: Opaque work-package identity: "work-package:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ActivityId.title: ActivityId
ActivityId.description: Opaque activity identity: "activity:" followed by a lowercase slug (the W036 ProgramOfWork grammar).

MilestoneId.title: MilestoneId
MilestoneId.description: Opaque milestone identity: "milestone:" followed by a lowercase slug.
